pretreatment: degreased in three different organic solvents: 2,2,2-trichloroethylene (TCE), acetone (ACE) and methanol, 5 min in each solvent. The substrate was then oxidized by boiling in HNO3, etched in dilute aqueous HF, and finally treated in a mixed solution of HCl, H2O2 and H2O in order to grow a thin oxide layer to protect the wafer from contaminants. After drying in a jet of nitrogen, the wafers were transferred into the reactor where the substrate was heated to 500°C for 30 min in H2 flow for thermal cleaning to remove the oxide layer
